patterns.note: Extensive use of horizontal product carousels to showcase various categories like 'New', 'Best Sellers', 'Exclusive Offers', and 'Skincare in Action', allowing for dense product display within a clean layout.
Prominent, bold sans-serif headings are used for hero and section titles, contrasted with a smaller, clean sans-serif for body text and product descriptions, maintaining high readability.

A vibrant, almost neon yellow is used as a primary accent in the hero section, providing a strong visual anchor against a predominantly white and light grey background, complemented by a deep forest green for the footer and key brand elements.

The main navigation bar transforms into a sticky, slightly condensed header upon scroll, while the initial promotional banner at the very top of the page disappears. Sections below the hero appear to reveal with a subtle fade-in or slide-up effect as they enter the viewport.

Dedicated full-width sections are used to highlight specific product categories or brand stories, often featuring a large image or video background with overlayed text, breaking up the product carousels.

technique_notes: The hero section utilizes a full-width image carousel, likely implemented with a library like Swiper, featuring large, impactful imagery and clear calls to action. Navigation arrows and pagination dots provide user control.

Scroll-triggered animations, likely using CSS keyframes, are employed to create a dynamic experience where content sections subtly fade or slide into view as the user scrolls down the page, enhancing engagement.

The header implements a sticky behavior where it reduces in height and potentially changes its background or shadow after the initial scroll, ensuring navigation remains accessible without consuming excessive screen space.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) with clear hierarchy, complemented by smaller, legible sans-serif body text and uppercase labels for categories.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners on buttons, product cards, and input fields, contributing to a soft, approachable feel.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced density with airy hero and full-width sections, transitioning to a more compact grid for product listings and carousels, maintaining clear visual separation.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a vibrant, almost neon yellow as a primary accent color in the hero section immediately grabs attention, setting a bold and energetic tone. This is effectively balanced by a clean, product-focused layout and a deep, earthy green footer, creating a unique brand identity that feels both fresh and established.
